title: Wishes
arc: A breath crosses a dandelion clock; the seeds drift up as evening turns to night, and each one unfolds into a star.
loop: The stars twinkle over the one seed that stayed, which sways and does not go.
poster: Inside the loop: the night full of stars, the last seed still on its stem.
alt: Sketch: a dandelion's seeds blow away on a breath of wind and rise into a darkening sky, where each seed turns into a star; one seed stays on the stem.

title: Doorframe
line: The marks climbed until they stopped. Then someone small stood against the door.
arc: Pencil height marks climb a door frame year after year, crowd together near the top and stop; after a long stillness a new mark appears at the bottom.
loop: A quiet morning afterwards: dust turning in the light.
poster: The settled final frame: every mark, and the new coloured one at the bottom.
alt: Sketch: pencil marks with names and dates climb a sunlit door frame year by year, then stop; a new mark in red appears at the very bottom.

title: Paper Boat
line: Go on. The water knows the way.
arc: A square of paper is folded into a hat and then a boat, set down on still water, and carried out towards the first light until it is almost gone.
loop: The water moving, and the boat, very far now, still going.
poster: Inside the loop: the tiny boat far out on the light's path across the water.
alt: Sketch: a sheet of paper folds itself into a paper boat, settles on still water at dawn and drifts away towards the horizon until it is a speck.

title: The Red Thread
line: It may tangle. It may stretch. It does not break.
arc: A red thread leaves one small house, knots itself up badly on the way and still reaches the other; then the knot lets go into one easy line and both windows light.
loop: A tug passes along the thread and back, each window brightening as it arrives.
poster: Inside the loop: the thread between two lit windows, a tug travelling it.
alt: Sketch: a red thread runs from the window of one house on a hill, tangles into a knot in the sky, reaches a house on a far hill, then smooths into a gentle line as both windows light.

title: Every Spring
line: It lets go of everything, every year, and begins again.
arc: A seed becomes a tree, each branch growing out of the last; then it lives one whole year.
loop: Blossom, leaf, amber, every leaf falling, snow, and blossom again.
poster: Inside the loop: autumn, the leaves letting go.
alt: Sketch: a tree grows branch by branch from a seed, then goes through a year: pink blossom, green leaves, orange leaves falling, snow, and blossom again.

title: The Lighthouse
line: It cannot stop the storm. It keeps the light turning.
arc: A lighthouse is drawn into a night storm; its lamp stutters on and off, then holds, and the beam slowly finds its pace.
loop: Rain, waves breaking on the rock, and the beam going round, steady.
poster: Inside the loop: the beam swept out over the storm.
alt: Sketch: a lighthouse on a rock in a rainy night storm flickers on, and its yellow beam turns steadily while waves break against the rock.

title: Kintsugi
line: Where it broke is where the gold is.
arc: A glazed bowl cracks and its pieces part for a long breath; they are brought back together and the cracks are traced in gold.
loop: A glint of light travels the gold seams.
poster: Inside the loop: the mended bowl, a glint on the gold.
alt: Sketch: a green glazed bowl breaks into three pieces that drift apart, come back together, and are mended with lines of gold along the cracks.

title: Two Cups
arc: Morning light on a wall, two cups of tea drawn with the same care; both steam, then one cup's steam thins and stops.
loop: One cup steaming beside one gone cold.
poster: Inside the loop: the left cup steaming, the right one still.
alt: Sketch: two teacups on saucers in morning window light; both steam at first, then only one does.

title: 52 Hertz
line: It sings at a pitch no other whale can hear. It sings anyway.
arc: A whale glides in deep water and sings; rings of song cross the whole empty ocean and fade, and nothing answers.
loop: The listening silence, and then the song again.
poster: Inside the loop: the song going out across the empty water.
alt: Sketch: a whale glides alone in deep blue water and sends out rings of song that spread across the empty ocean and fade.

title: Small Light
line: The dark is very large. The flame does not know that.
arc: In darkness a spark fails; a flame kindles, gutters to almost nothing, and then takes, and its light finds a candle that was there all along.
loop: The flame breathing in a very large dark.
poster: Inside the loop: the candle lit, its light at full reach.
alt: Sketch: in darkness a small flame nearly goes out, then catches, and its warm light reveals a candle on a table.
